Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and G4621; without (taking) food:--fasting.
BiblicalUsage: Paul told the men on the ship that this was the fourteenth day they had waited and gone without food, and he urged them to eat for their health. The word describes the empty stomachs of men who had been too afraid to eat.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul's care for their bodies showed the same gospel he preached, that God looks after the whole person.
